targets.query:
from(bucket: "fbp-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "node_stats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "in_count" or r._field == "out_count")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.node_id + "." + r._field }))

from(bucket: "fbp-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "node_stats" and r._field == "avg_time_ms")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.node_id }))

from(bucket: "fbp-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wire_stats" and r._field == "delivered")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.wire_id }))

from(bucket: "fbp-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wire_stats" and r._field == "queue_size")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.wire_id }))

from(bucket: "fbp-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_stats_1m" and r.sensor_name == "temperature")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "avg" or r._field == "min" or r._field == "max")
